_doc: RADE manifest (contract: rhope-ops/RADE schemas/rade-manifest.schema.json). Built by the RADE engine through scripts/build_paste_bundles.py (a pinned shim, see scripts/rade.lock.json). Each bundle is one round: a self-contained PowerShell text the PFM copies from its raw page and pastes into Windows PowerShell ISE (F5). It writes the files, then opens RADE, the Redacted Application Deployment Engine (a window; text prompts if no window can open): steps run one by one with a live log and PASS/FAIL counts, then one results folder (Rounds\\<round>: a report file plus copies of the PDFs, to attach to one e-mail; zips do not cross the boundary) and a summary for the clipboard. It runs only the steps inside it (PFM 3A). A step's "default" may be {passed, paths}: the step is ticked only when those files changed since the round that passed it; after a round passes it, set passed to the new hash (PFM 14 Nov 26). Never hand-edit scripts/gov/paste/*.ps1: change this file or the sources and rebuild. A step may list "needs" (check ids in the engine's $checkDefs) and "estimate" (minutes, used until a real run time exists). "apps" is the embedded catalog the Choose screen lists (name, plain-English summary, step names); without it, one application has every step. A guide step may set "doneText" (its Done button) and "doneLog" (the log line on Done).

bundles.title: Round R26 r2: the big test. Tries the split front end with fake data: list forms for other people (T2, T4, T7, T10), your 90-161.Z window preview, the flows (T3, T5, T6, T8), and 2 own-mailbox e-mails with and without [TEST] (T9)

steps.name: T21 Make the probe list and library r2
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes the list "90161Z Probe" and the library "90161Z Probe Files", lets site visitors write to that list only, adds 2 fake files and the test page. About 2 minutes (estimate).
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.

steps.name: T21 Import the probe solution r2
steps.note: You import the solution "90-161.Z probe" (3 flows) and select Done. About 8 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
2. If Power Automate asks you to sign in: sign in with your CAC.
3. On the left, select Solutions (it can be under More).
4. Select "Import solution".
5. Select Browse.
6. Select the box "File name".
7. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard).
8. Select Open.
9. Select Next.
10. In each of the 5 connection boxes, select the arrow.
11. In each list that opens, select your existing connection.
12. If a box has no connection: select "New connection" in that box.
13. If you selected "New connection": select Create.
14. If a sign-in window opens: sign in with your CAC.
15. If you made a new connection: return to the browser tab where you started the import.
16. If you made a new connection: select Refresh.
17. Select Next.
18. In the box "1 Site URL", type the test site address (it starts with https:// and is the one in the RADE box "Site address").
19. In the box "3 Shared mailbox", type the e-mail address of your office's shared mailbox.
20. Select Import.
21. Wait for the line "Successfully imported" (1 to 3 minutes, estimate).
22. Select the solution "90-161.Z probe".
23. Look at the Status column: the 3 flows "90161Z T21 Probe ..." must read On.
24. If a flow reads Off: select that flow.
25. If you selected a flow that reads Off: select "Turn on".
26. Return to the RADE window.
27. Select "Done: imported".
If the import fails: select "Download log file", then select "It failed" and type the first red error line (no names).
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)
after: T21 Make the probe list and library r2
steps.help: Send the results as they are; the import log step reads the log if you downloaded it.

steps.name: T17 Import log reader r2
steps.note: Runs only if an import failed: copies the error rows of an import log saved in the last 3 hours to T17, addresses masked. Otherwise it reports SKIPPED.

steps.name: T21 Run the flow tests r2
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Starts the 3 flows and waits up to 14 minutes: files (T3, T5), fields (T6), search and members (T7, T8), 3 test e-mails (T9). About 15 minutes (estimate).
after: T21 Import the probe solution r2
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A FAILED line is a result of the probe, not a fault of the round.

steps.name: T21 Open the test page r2
steps.note: Opens the test page in your browser. No sign-in. A few seconds (estimate).
after: T21 Make the probe list and library r2
steps.help: The step can be run again.

steps.name: T21 Look at the draft r2
steps.note: Test T2. You open the fake draft and its PDF copy in the browser and post 1 fake comment. About 5 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
2. Select "Open the fake draft".
3. If a sign-in window opens: sign in with your CAC.
4. Look at the new tab: the fake draft should open in Word for the web.
5. If the draft opened in Word for the web: select the tab Review.
6. If you selected Review: select "New Comment".
7. In the comment box, type: FAKE COMMENT R26
8. Press Ctrl+Enter.
9. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
10. Select "Open the PDF copy".
11. Look at the new tab: the PDF should open in the browser.
12. Return to the RADE window.
13. Select "Done: I looked".
If a link opens an error or nothing: go on with the next step and pick the answer that fits.
If the test page is closed: select "Show file in folder", then double-click "90161Z-T21-links-r2.html".
after: T21 Open the test page r2
T21 Run the flow tests r2

answers.prompt: What did "Open the fake draft" open?
choices: Word for the web: I could read it
An error or a sign-in loop

answers.prompt: Could you post the fake comment in Word for the web?
What did "Open the PDF copy" open?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: looked at the draft.

steps.name: T21 Add a row with a person r2
steps.note: Test T7. You add one row in the list form and pick a person in its person box. About 3 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
2. Select "Open the new row form".
3. In the box "Title", type: T7a
4. Select the box "ProbePerson".
5. In the box "ProbePerson", type the first 3 letters of your own last name.
6. Look at the list under the box: it should show names.
7. Select your own name in that list.
8. Select Save.
9. Return to the RADE window.
10. Select "Done: row added".
If no names show, or your name is not there: select Save, then pick the answer that fits.
If the test page is closed: select "Show file in folder", then double-click "90161Z-T21-links-r2.html".
after: T21 Open the test page r2

answers.prompt: What did the box "ProbePerson" show after 3 letters?
Did a name show more than the name, such as an office or an e-mail address?

steps.name: T21 Open the PDF to sign r2
steps.note: Opens the fake PDF in your PDF program and puts the path for the signed copy on the clipboard. No sign-in. A few seconds (estimate).
after: T21 Make the probe list and library r2
steps.help: The step can be run again.

steps.name: T21 Sign and attach the PDF r2
steps.note: Test T10. You sign the fake PDF with your CAC and attach the signed copy in the list form. About 7 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. Look at Acrobat: it shows the fake PDF "FAKE - 90161Z R26 - sign here".
2. In Acrobat, select "All tools".
3. Select "Use a certificate".
4. Select "Digitally sign".
5. Draw a box on the page with the mouse, where the signature should go.
6. In the list, select your CAC certificate for signing (not the one for e-mail).
7. Select Continue.
8. Select Sign.
9. Look at Acrobat: it asks where to save the signed copy.
10. Select the box "File name".
11. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V (the path for the signed copy is on the clipboard).
12. Select Save.
13. If Windows asks for your PIN: type your CAC PIN.
14. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
15. Select "Open the new row form".
16. In the box "Title", type: T10
17. Select "Add attachments".
18. Select the box "File name".
19. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V.
20. Select Open.
21. Select Save.
22. Return to the RADE window.
23. Select "Done: attached".
If the PDF opened in the browser and not in Acrobat: select "It failed" and type: opened in the browser
after: T21 Open the PDF to sign r2

answers.prompt: Could you sign the fake PDF with your CAC?
Could you attach the signed copy in the form?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: signed and attached.

steps.name: T21 Second person r2
steps.note: Test T4. A person with only Read on the test site adds one row with the form link you send. About 5 minutes (estimate). If nobody is free today, select Skip.
guide: 1. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
2. Right-click "Open the new row form".
3. Select "Copy link".
4. In Teams, open a chat with a person who has only Read on the test site.
5. In the chat box, press Ctrl+V.
6. In the chat box, type: Please open this link, type T4a in Title, select Save, and tell me what you saw.
7. Press Enter.
8. Wait for the answer of the person in the chat: the row saved, or no permission.
9. Return to the RADE window.
10. Select "Done: second person".
If nobody is free today: select Skip.
after: T21 Open the test page r2

answers.prompt: What did the second person see?

steps.name: T22 Open the 90-161.Z window r1
steps.note: Opens a full-screen preview of your 90-161.Z window with fake data: 5 cards. Select its buttons, then close it with its X. Nothing is read, saved or sent. About 5 minutes (estimate).
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.

steps.name: T22 Judge the window r1
steps.note: You answer 4 questions about the preview window. About 2 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. If the 90-161.Z window is still on the screen: close it with its X.
2. Select "Done: I judged".

answers.prompt: Does the window look like your vision of the 90-161.Z app?
Did every card fit in the window with no scroll bar?
What would you change first? One line, no names.

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: judged the window.

steps.name: T21 Read the test results r2
steps.note: Signs in (CAC) and reads what the forms and the flows wrote: T4, T7, T10 and the last e-mail read (T9). Field names and counts only. About 3 minutes (estimate).
after: T21 Run the flow tests r2
steps.help: Send the results as they are.

steps.name: T21 Check your e-mail r2
steps.note: Test T9. You look for the 3 test e-mails in your Inbox and in Junk Email. About 3 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. Open Outlook (the program on your computer).
2. Select the folder Inbox.
3. In the search box at the top, type: 90161Z T9
4. Press Enter.
5. Look at the subjects found: each one has S3, S5 or S6 in it.
If nothing is found: that is a result; go on with the next step.
6. Select the folder "Junk Email".
7. In the search box at the top, type: 90161Z T9
8. Press Enter.
9. Look at the subjects found.
10. Return to the RADE window.
11. Select "Done: I looked".
after: T21 Run the flow tests r2

answers.prompt: Which test e-mails are in your Inbox? Type S3, S5 or S6 (one or more), or none.
Which test e-mails are in Junk Email? Type S3, S5 or S6 (one or more), or none.
Did Outlook or an e-mail tell you that a message was blocked or quarantined?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: looked for the test e-mails.

steps.name: T21 Remove the probe list and library r2
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Moves the list "90161Z Probe" and the library "90161Z Probe Files" to the site Recycle Bin (restorable for 93 days). Removes nothing else. About 1 minute (estimate).
after: T21 Make the probe list and library r2
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.

steps.name: T21 Remove the probe solution r2
steps.note: You delete what the round made outside the site: 1 solution, 1 OneDrive folder and the test e-mails. About 5 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
2. On the left, select Solutions (it can be under More).
3. Select the three dots beside "90-161.Z probe".
4. Select "Delete from this environment".
5. Select Delete.
6. Open File Explorer.
7. On the left, select "OneDrive - United States Air Force".
8. If the folder "90161Z-probe" is there: right-click that folder.
9. If you right-clicked the folder: select Delete.
10. In Outlook, select the folder Inbox.
11. In the search box at the top, type: 90161Z T9
12. Press Enter.
13. If e-mails are found: press Ctrl+A.
14. If e-mails are found: press Delete.
15. Return to the RADE window.
16. Select "Done: removed".
If something does not delete: select "It failed" and type its name and the first line of the message.
